topic: Modeling historical data for airport analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on modeling a full year of historical data, specifically for an airport location. The required period is defined as 2024-05-01 to 2025-05-01, with current data available up to 2025-01-23.

Key requirements include:
*   Collecting all metrics, but restricting the scope only to airport categories to prevent contamination from other segments.
*   Ensuring the resulting dataset is accessible via DataCorp.
*   The agreed methodology for data aggregation involves using aggregates and then unrolling them in reverse order, similar to a previous process used for Campinas.

The conversation also addressed discrepancies found in the 'total traffic cluster' data starting from 2025-04-23, which was traced back to a known bug related to Brazil that someone had recently been debugging.
decisions: The full year of historical data modeling period is set as 2024-05-01 to 2025-05-01.
Data collection must be limited to airport metrics only.
The methodology for the model will use aggregates, unrolled in reverse order.
action_items: [me] will calculate and provide data up to 2025-04-30 (excluding 30.04) by tomorrow.
